So I get to live my life as a mental patient (and have my family destroyed and everything I ever worked for removed from me unlawfully) because they don’t like reality and deny me my human right to not be tortured and kidnapped should a bus driver I had a disagreement with decides to refer me for mental health treatment after ‘spiking’ me with date rape drugs.
